map.总停车距离 = 反应距离（车速 × 反应时间）+ 制动距离（v²/2a）。车速翻: Total stopping distance = reaction distance (speed × reaction time) + braking distance (v²/2a). Doubling speed roughly quadruples braking distance, and a lower wet-road grip coefficient stretches it further.
map.密度低于约 0.3 t/m³ 属轻泡货，按体积计费更亏；高于 1 t/m³ 属重: Below about 0.3 t/m³ counts as light bulky, where volumetric billing costs more; above 1 t/m³ counts as heavy, limited by payload. Compute the density before choosing the billing basis.
map.💡 吨公里成本只含燃油，实为「燃油吨公里成本」。报价还须加折旧、保险、司机工时、: 💡 Note this tonne-km figure covers fuel only, strictly "fuel cost per tonne-km". Quotes must also carry depreciation, insurance, driver hours, road tolls and handling, and those fixed costs weigh heavier on short one-off jobs.
map.配送前按货物重量、体积、里程与车型核算吨公里成本，报价或控本。: Before delivery, work out cost per tonne-km from cargo weight, volume, distance and vehicle type to quote or control cost.
map.对比自有车与外包运费，决策运力配置。: Compare running your own fleet against outsourced freight when deciding capacity.
map.多趟次按空载率与油耗优化路线与装载率。: Across many trips, optimize routing and load factor by watching empty running and fuel use.
map.货车载重 5 吨、百公里油耗 20L、油价 7.5 元/L，跑 300km 油费: A 5-tonne truck using 20L/100km at 7.5 yuan/L over 300km spends 300/100×20×7.5 = 450 yuan, giving 450/(5×300) = 0.3 yuan per tonne-km. At only 60% load factor the real figure rises to 0.5 yuan.
map.空载率怎么影响成本？: How does empty running affect cost?
map.吨公里成本按实载重量摊，空载率高则单位成本陡升。提升装载率与回程带货是降成本关键: Cost per tonne-km is spread over the weight actually carried, so a high empty-running share pushes unit cost up steeply. Raising the load factor and finding backhauls is the key to cutting cost.
map.折旧、保险、司机工时属固定成本，长途大批量摊薄后占比小，短途零散单固定成本占比高: Depreciation, insurance and driver hours are fixed costs that shrink proportionally on long high-volume runs but dominate short one-off jobs, so quotes must cover them.
